Definition: properly, to be dense, i.e. tough or severe (in various applications)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be hard, be severe, be fierce, be harsh; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be hard, be difficult; 1a2) to be hard, be severe; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be ill-treated; 1b2) to be hard pressed; 1c) (Piel) to have severe labour (of women); 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to make difficult, make difficulty; 1d2) to make severe, make burdensome; 1d3) to make hard, make stiff, make stubborn; 1d3a) of obstinacy (fig); 1d4) to show stubbornness
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
